ns2:section.sectionText: The course will examine the current state of global health informatics from both a local and global perspective, including opportunities and challenges. Focus will be placed on the transition from paper-based records to electronic systems, with a particular emphasis on large international open-source initiatives and use of mobile devices. Guest speakers will share their experiences with WHO, international education based on mobile devices, and regulatory issues. Meets with LIS 490 GHG, LIS 490 GHU and INFO 490 GHG. This class will meet in 341 LIS Bldg.
